headline: A communications business needed to prove it could be trusted with other people's data.
challenge: ICT and communications providers sit under some of the closest regulatory attention in Nigeria's business environment, with data protection obligations layered on top of sector rules.
delivered: Regulatory compliance review against telecommunications sector requirements
Data protection policy development and documentation
Corporate governance and statutory filing support
Advisory on licensing and permit obligations
impact: A communications business able to operate with documented regulatory and data protection compliance behind it — not just in front of it.
